mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 9.5% over three consecutive months indicates improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative or flat 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong underlying demand momentum, which drives corporate earnings expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 630.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0 in same month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 in two consecutive months signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a prior decline indicates a recovery in consumer demand, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1.5% MoM after two consecutive monthly declines
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 20d returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, prompting expectations of tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of triggered instances, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, which strengthens consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE declines > 0.2pp and PAYEMS increases > 50k in same month
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 60d returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) on a quarterly basis, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 1.0% and HOUST > 630.0 in same quarter
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60d returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
